title: SEO Agency Manchester: Google and AI Answers | 22 Signals
description: An SEO agency Manchester firms use to rank in Google and show up in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and AI Overview answers: technical SEO, local search and content.
h1: SEO agency Manchester companies use for Google and AI answers
intro: We help established Manchester companies get found by people searching for what they sell, in Google and in AI assistants. Our SEO and generative engine optimisation work covers technical fixes, local search and Google Business Profile, answer-first content, how your business is described across the web, outside mentions and plain monthly reporting tied to enquiries.

p: Buyers in Manchester still type into Google, but more of them now ask ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini for a shortlist, and Google itself often answers with an AI Overview before the blue links. A firm can rank on page one and still be missing from the answer the buyer actually reads.

So the job now has two halves. Classic SEO makes sure Google can crawl, understand and rank your pages. Generative engine optimisation, or GEO, makes sure AI assistants have clear, consistent and well-sourced information about you, so you show up in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Google AI Overview answers when someone asks for a provider like you.

list: Technical SEO: crawling, indexing, speed, structured data, internal linking and fixing what Screaming Frog and Search Console flag.
Local SEO and Google Business Profile, including categories, services, reviews and location pages done honestly.
Content: service pages, guides and answers written for the questions Manchester buyers actually ask.
Entity work: making sure your business is described the same way across your site, directories, profiles and press.
Answer-first pages that AI assistants and featured snippets can quote cleanly.
Outside mentions: digital PR, partner pages and industry publications that earn links and citations.
Monthly reporting on rankings, AI answer presence, traffic and, most importantly, enquiries.

p: Manchester searches behave differently from national ones. A buyer in Stockport, Salford or Altrincham may search with the town name, the borough, a district such as Spinningfields or Ancoats, or just near me. Google weighs your Business Profile, your reviews, your address and how relevant your pages are to each of those.

We map the terms that matter for your service across the city region, check where you appear in the local pack today and build pages that deserve to rank, rather than thin copies with a town name swapped in. Google treats those copies as doorway pages, and buyers see through them.

list: Law, accountancy and financial firms in Spinningfields: high-value searches where one enquiry can be worth months of fees, and where solicitors must also follow SRA transparency rules on their websites.
Fashion, beauty and e-commerce brands: category pages, product schema, faceted navigation that does not waste crawl budget, and Google Shopping alignment.
Manufacturers and B2B suppliers: technical product content that engineers and buyers search for by spec, part or standard.
Clinics and health businesses: treatment pages written with care, clear credentials and reviews handled properly.
Media, creative and tech firms around MediaCityUK and the Northern Quarter: portfolio and service pages that rank in a crowded field.

p: Right now, 10 of the businesses we work with sit in Google's top five for their main searches and show up in ChatGPT's answers. Several are in competitive service categories where one new client is worth a lot, which is a similar position to many Manchester professional firms.

For a US aesthetics practice we ran a 35-question audit across five AI engines: the real questions patients ask, put to each assistant, recording whether the practice appeared, how it was described and which sources the answer relied on. That showed exactly which pages and outside mentions to fix. We run the same kind of check for Manchester clients, using the questions your buyers ask, and repeat it so you can see the change over time.

sections.h: How it works, remotely from London
p: Our head office is in London and we have no Manchester office. Search work is done on your website, your Search Console and your Business Profile, so it runs entirely remotely, with a monthly report and call during UK working hours. Manchester shares London's clock, so there is no lag between your team and ours. If you would like a strategy session in person, your Signal Lead will come to Manchester when the project needs it.

p: Ranking problems are often web development problems, and traffic means little if the page does not convert or the ads are pulling against it. We run SEO alongside web development, paid media and content under one Signal Lead, so fixes actually get made. We will never promise a position in Google or an AI assistant, because nobody honestly can; we promise the work, the dates and transparent reporting. faqs.q: What is the difference between SEO and GEO?
faqs.a: SEO is about ranking your pages in search engines like Google. GEO, generative engine optimisation, is about making sure AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews, have accurate information about you and include you in their answers. They overlap heavily: clear pages, consistent facts and trusted outside mentions help both.

faqs.q: Do I need an SEO agency Manchester-based to rank locally?
faqs.a: No. Local rankings depend on your Google Business Profile, reviews, relevant pages and mentions, not on where your agency sits. We work on all of these remotely from London. What you do need is a real address or service area in Greater Manchester; we never create fake addresses to win local results.

faqs.q: How long does SEO take to show results in Manchester?
faqs.a: Technical fixes and Business Profile improvements can show changes within weeks. Content and authority take longer, often several months, depending on how competitive your searches are. We set out what to expect in the plan and report monthly, so you can see progress in rankings, AI answers and enquiries rather than waiting blind.

faqs.q: Can you guarantee a top position in Google?
faqs.a: No, and you should be wary of anyone who does. Google and AI assistants decide their own results. What we commit to is the work, the timeline and honest reporting. Our track record is that 10 of the businesses we work with sit in Google's top five for their main searches.

faqs.q: Do you write content for regulated firms?
faqs.a: Yes. For solicitors, financial advisers and clinics, we write content that is accurate and careful, check facts and legal references, and have it approved by your team before it goes live. For US personal injury firms, for example, we check every statute cited in monthly content. The same care applies to UK rules.

faqs.q: What do your monthly SEO reports show?
faqs.a: Rankings for the terms that matter, whether you appear in AI answers for your key questions, organic traffic, Business Profile activity and, most importantly, enquiries from search. Each report also lists what we did that month and what comes next, in plain English.
